sources: https://www.coawi.org/DocumentCenter/View/3569/Prentice-Park-Campground-Terms--Conditionsdocx (Kreher and Prentice terms and conditions, PDF)

values.note: 2027 RV site $55 a night, $330 a week, $1,320 a month (RV sites 2, 4 and 6 only); tent sites $30. On Campspot (read 2026-10-13) the park added a 3% convenience fee and Campspot its own booking fee. An optional site-lock fee guarantees the chosen site. Cancelling 7+ days out costs 3%, later 50%; no refund for no-shows or early departures.

fees.source: https://www.coawi.org/381/Campgrounds ('2027 Camping Rates / Daily Camping Rates (does not include fees and taxes) ... Prentice Park $55.00 / Prentice Park Tent $30.00'; weekly 'Prentice Park $330.00'; monthly 'Prentice Park $1,320.00'); terms PDF ('A site may not be occupied by more than eight (8) persons'; 'RV sites 2, 4, and 6 ... are available for month long rentals'); https://www.coawi.org/541/Prentice-Park-Campground (site lock fee, refund policy), read 2026-11-16

hookups.source: https://www.coawi.org/541/Prentice-Park-Campground ('RV Sites with onsite water & electric (30 amp service)'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: 7 RV sites (the camp host occupies site 7) and 6 primitive tent sites.

sites.source: https://www.coawi.org/541/Prentice-Park-Campground ('6 primitive tent sites (no electricity or water) and 7 RV sites with onsite water & electricity'; 'contact our Camp Host on RV Site #7'); 2026 site map (RV 1-6 + CH, T1-T6), read 2026-11-16

facilities.source: https://www.coawi.org/541/Prentice-Park-Campground ('Restrooms & Shower house (free for campers ...)'; 'There is no dump station at Prentice Park, but campers are able to use the station at Kreher Park'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: In 2026 both city campgrounds stayed open to October 25 in mild weather; off-season camping may be offered depending on weather.

season.source: https://www.coawi.org/381/Campgrounds ('Campground reservations are able to be reserved from May 15th to October 15th. The campground will close after October 15th, but off season camping may be available depending on weather conditions!'; 'UPDATE! Due to mild weather conditions Kreher RV Park and Prentice Park Campgrounds will both be open until October 25th!'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: Reservation only, online on Campspot or by phone with Ashland Parks & Recreation (715-682-7059); 2027 bookings open February 10, 2027. Self check-in by Campspot email; check-in 1 PM, check-out 11 AM. Tent sites 14 nights at most.

booking.source: https://www.coawi.org/381/Campgrounds ('Reservations for the 2027 camping season will open on February 10th, 2027!'; 'click on the link for Prentice Park ... or call into our office to reserve a site with our staff at 715-682-7059'); terms PDF ('Occupancy of Kreher and Prentice Park campsites is reservation only.'; 'Check In: 1:00 PM / Check Out: 11:00 AM'; 'No one may occupy a tent campsite continuously for more than 14 days'); https://www.coawi.org/541/Prentice-Park-Campground (self check-in via Campspot email), read 2026-11-16

note: City of Ashland park on the city's western edge, along an artesian spring and Fish Creek, with flowing artesian wells, 2+ miles of ADA trail linking to the waterfront trail, a playground and pavilions. Campers use the free dump station at Kreher Park. --Claude
summary: City campground pages, 2026 site map and terms read: 2027 rate $55 confirmed (2027 posting), 8 people max; 30 A water/electric confirmed; 13 sites confirmed (7 RV incl. host, 6 tent); showers, no dump confirmed; season May 15-Oct 24 -> May 15-Oct 15 (2026 extended to Oct 25); Campspot, reservation only. Not waterfront kept.
flags: PHONE: stored 715-682-7059 is the Parks & Recreation office the page gives for booking (kept); the page footer lists 'Prentice Park Campground Phone: 715-682-7071'.
LONG-STAY: only RV sites 2, 4 and 6 may be rented by the month ($1,320); the rest sell by the night or week. City-run, Google 4.4 (141). Passes.

SITES: the camp host lives on RV site 7, so 6 RV sites are for the public. No length limit stated; the page says 'Whether you drive a Class A motor home, or prefer the simplicity of a 2-person tent, we have a site for you.'
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept (park along an artesian spring and Fish Creek, a small creek).
